card.name: Start of medical terms after "Primary"
card.fires_on: The first piece of a long medical term (dys-, hyper-) right after the word "Primary" in indication headings, such as primary dysmenorrhea or primary hypercholesterolemia. It also fires weakly on "pulmonary" in embolism or pulmonary vein terms.

modes.label: Primary + dys/hyper
modes.description: The opening piece "dys" or "hyper" of a condition name following "Primary" in dosing or indication text.
modes.example: For the treatment of primary<< dys>>menorrhea: 500

modes.label: Pulmonary terms
modes.description: The word "pulmonary" or its middle piece in embolism, edema or vein-disease terms.
modes.example: Increased incidence of<< pulmonary>> embolism, venous and arterial
